campus_notes: Compiled 2026-11-26 from Stephen F. Austin State University Residence Life (sfasu.edu/reslife): the 14 residence halls on its Our Halls page, each hall's At a Glance and furniture-dimension page, the move-in FAQ and the Community Guidelines. SFA publishes the unit size for Griffith (11' x 15'), Hall 14 (12' x 15'), Kerr (11' x 15'), Lumberjack Landing (14' x 25'), Steen (12' x 22') and Wisely (10' x 18'), and bedroom sizes for the Lumberjack Village 4 townhomes; those rooms are data_confidence high. Hall 10, North, South, Lumberjack Lodge and Lumberjack Village 1-3 publish no room or bedroom size (Lodge and Village 1 give only whole-apartment square footage), so those rooms use the site's estimate fallback and are labelled "Estimated based on similar rooms. Official size not published." Most halls have bunkable standard twin beds (39" x 75" mattress, shorter than Twin XL); Landing, Lodge and Steen have XL twins, and Village 3 and 4 have XL full beds. Every hall has air conditioning. First-time, first-year students live on campus unless granted an off-campus permit.
